# BadgeWars

> BadgeWars is software for personal profile customization through dynamic, embeddable SVG badges and an API. The public website is available in Spanish and English.

BC are closed-loop software credits. The price reference is 1 BC = 1 EUR, before applicable taxes; checkout may offer conversion into supported local currencies. The minimum top-up is 5 BC. Credits have no monetary value outside BadgeWars, are not transferable, and cannot be redeemed for cash. Mandatory consumer rights apply. Payment availability is shown inside the authenticated account; this document does not enable purchases.

## Badges and public listings

- [The Apex Flex](https://badgewars.com/leaderboard/flex): competitive positions determined by BC spent; entry starts at 1 BC. Only a confirmed, atomic purchase updates the rank. A concurrent rejected purchase does not spend credits. The initial ranking is open without an announced end date; future closed rankings retain their final positions and badges.
- [Don't Click This](https://badgewars.com/leaderboard/bait): a playful profile badge whose state and holder change through paid interactions.
- [Build Funded](https://badgewars.com/leaderboard/funded): unlimited personal developer badges for a fixed activation cost. The directory lists their owners and acquisition dates; ownership does not transfer between users.
- [Trust Bag](https://badgewars.com/leaderboard/trust): community support increases points without a cap. The SVG shows the current reliability rank and visual tier. Points reflect paid support, not independent verification of professional quality. Contribution details are private; an owner may show up to five leading contributors.
- [Genesis](https://badgewars.com/leaderboard/genesis): a fixed edition of ten personal badges, with every holder listed separately. The activation price is 1,000 BC.

## Accounts and embeds

- [Badge catalog](https://badgewars.com/): descriptions, current public states and navigation.
- [Personal collection](https://badgewars.com/collection): Google or GitHub login is required to obtain personal HTML, Markdown and SVG embed codes. Do not request another user's private collection or import code.

Each account sets its public handle in My badges before acquiring badges or contributing. Handles use 2–24 Latin letters, numbers or underscores, are unique without regard to letter case, and are locked for 14 days after being set or changed. A change applies to that account's public badges and contributions without changing its personal links, levels or final closed ranks.

- [Public state API](https://badgewars.com/api/arena): read-only published badge state and public listings. Data can be cached; no wallet or private contribution details are included.

Embeds load a personal SVG dynamically. Suspension or payment review disables the active badge and shows a neutral account-status design linking back to the site. Do not present suspended badges as active. Authentication, purchases and support actions require the user's own session and confirmation; no anonymous purchase or account-management agent tools are provided.

## Rules and support

- [Rules and terms](https://badgewars.com/terms): badge mechanics, credits, ownership, account review and mandatory rights.
- [Refund policy](https://badgewars.com/refunds): top-up incidents, reversals, partial refunds, payment review, suspension and reactivation. No cash redemption of credits; statutory rights are preserved.
- [Privacy](https://badgewars.com/privacy): personal data and authentication.
- [Legal notice](https://badgewars.com/legal): platform operator and Dodo Payments Merchant of Record roles.
- [Cookies and local storage](https://badgewars.com/cookies): browser storage and preferences.
- [Support](mailto:support@badgewars.com): account and top-up incidents.

## Español

BadgeWars ofrece badges SVG personales actualizables por API. La referencia es 1 BC = 1 EUR antes de impuestos, con recarga mínima de 5 BC y posible conversión de moneda en el checkout. Los BC carecen de valor monetario externo y no se canjean por efectivo. Consulta las reglas en español y las clasificaciones públicas mediante los enlaces anteriores. Los códigos personales solo se facilitan en el área del titular. Los derechos legales obligatorios se mantienen.
